chunks: And those who kept away from false gods so that they would not worship them, and turned in repentance to God, for them are the glad tidings. So give glad tidings to My servants.

key_terms.الطَّاغُوت: False gods or idols; that which is exceeded in transgression

ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of those who receive glad tidings from God according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Taghut' encompasses not only idols but also any authority or entity that diverts worship from Allah, including unjust rulers and false ideologies. The verse emphasizes 'Inabah' (turning back) as an active, conscious return to divine guidance, promising glad tidings to those who maintain this monotheistic purity. This serves as a foundational criterion for distinguishing the true believers from those influenced by worldly powers.
